hero_title.en: Fuel Academic Excellence with Real-World Media Intelligence

hero_description.en: Give your students and faculty access to the same datasets by the Media Technology Monitor (MTM) that media experts, industry regulators and scholars have relied on for over two decades. Nationally representative, bilingual, and rigorous enough for peer review.

dataset_title.en: Multiple datasets. Hundreds of research directions.

dataset_description.en: MTM tracks how Canadians consume media and technology across 5000+ variables — spanning platforms, behaviours, demographics, and devices. Browse by topic to find what your research needs.

topic_1_example_question.en: What share of Canadians watched a live sporting event online last month?

topic_1_variables.en: Watched sports online, Sports, SVOD, ESPN+, TSN

topic_2_example_question.en: How does Twitch viewership differ between Teens and Gen Z Canadians?

topic_3_example_question.en: How rapidly has AI tool adoption grown among Canadians since 2023?

topic_3_variables.en: ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Age 18 to 24, Grok

topic_4_example_question.en: How does gaming device ownership vary across income levels in Canada?

topic_4_variables.en: Game console owners, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, XBox, Income

topic_5_example_question.en: How do media consumption patterns differ between English- and French-speaking Canadians?

topic_5_variables.en: Anglophone, Francophone, Social Media, Language spoken at Home, News, TV hours

topic_6_example_question.en: Are younger Canadians abandoning traditional news formats in favour of social media?

topic_6_variables.en: Read online news, News consumption platform, Social media, CTV, YouTube

dataset_footer.en: Over 5000+ variables available across 200+ topic areas, searchable and filterable in our tools.

tools_title.en: Powerful tools designed for serious inquiry

education_tools_analytic_description.en: Query MTM's full dataset by platform, region, language, and demographic. Build custom cross-tabs in minutes, track adoption curves over time, and model where your audience will be in three years — all at the click of a button.

education_tools_census_description.en: Map your audience at the postal code level. Identify underserved communities, size local markets, and benchmark your reach against the national population — all from a single dashboard sourced directly from Statistics Canada census data.

stat_description.en: No extra charge for faculty, students and staff

workflow_title.en: Gold standard research all of your research needs

workflow_description.en: We provide universities and colleges with the insights needed to drive innovation and learning across every specialization and at every stage of their academic journey.

workflow_step_1_description.en: Ground assignments in the most up-to-date research and build market-ready skills by navigating the same metrics and trends used by Canada’s top industry leaders and governmental institutions.

workflow_step_2_description.en: Enhance your curriculum with authentic, up-to-date reports and datasets that turn abstract concepts into tangible lessons.

workflow_step_3_description.en: Support your research in the country's most robust longitudinal media studies, ensuring your findings are both current and credible.

usecases_description.en: Learn how the MTM offers essential content and tools for professors and students alike

usecase_1_description.en: A professor is looking for a historical and current data on the state of broadcast TV when developing a new curriculum.

usecase_1_variables.en: TV viewership, TV hours, Region, Age

usecase_1_cta.en: Examine usage of linear TV and channels across a wide range of demographics via the Data Analysis Tool, or read the TV distribution report for a broader overview.

usecase_2_description.en: A student writing a masters thesis on different locations for data centres across different communities.

usecase_2_cta.en: Leverage the Compare feature in the Census Tool for a granular look at different prospective locations.

testimonial_title.en: What academic institutions are saying about us

testimonial_quote.en: As the author of nine editions of a Canadian Advertising textbook, I have included data from Media Technology Monitor (MTM) for the past five editions to enhance the Broadcast, Internet and Social Media Chapters. I believe the data improved the quality allowing students to understand the complexities of advertising planning decisions. The textbook contains the most current consumer media technology usage and adoption data to keep it in a leading market position. MTM is a wonderful partner and I look forward to working with them for the next edition.

testimonial_attribution.en: Michael Guolla, Professor, University of Ottawa
